title.zh: 规定新比斯开 Aglipay 市镇政府所在地设于 Guinalbin 的法案
title.en: An Act to Provide that the Seat of Government of the Municipality of Aglipay, Nueva Vizcaya, be Located at Guinalbin
title.orig: An Act to Provide that the Seat of Government of the Municipality of Aglipay, Nueva Vizcaya, be Located at Guinalbin

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2151_1959.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: The seat of government of the Municipality of Aglipay, Nueva Vizcaya, shall be located at Guinalbin.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 24, 1959.
